Divith Reddy Adulla, the former under-8 champion took on Advik Agarwal - the IM elect and one of the best talents in Indian chess. This game happened at the National under-15 championships 2026 in Hyderabad in the 5th round. It was a crazy Najdorf with a crazy tactic! IM Sagar Shah commentates!
Video: ChessBase India
